text:
Situation: Etomidate injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2022-10-05 across multiple manufacturers including Caplin Steriles, Eugia US LLC, Gland Pharma, Hikma Pharmaceuticals, Hospira, and Mylan Institutional. As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 49 months. Corvale East holds three lots totaling 175 vials with 5 to 10.9 days on hand. Corvale General holds three lots totaling 400.5 vials with 11.1 to 24 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds two lots totaling 92 vials with 20 to 24.3 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows etomidate injection in shortage since 2022-10-05. Hospira's plant (FEI 1021343) received OAI classifications on 2010-01-19, 2011-06-17, and 2011-08-04, with a Warning Letter issued 2010-04-12. Hikma Farmaceutica Portugal (FEI 3002807173) received an OAI classification on 2014-03-28 and a Warning Letter on 2014-10-21. Recent inspections were classified VAI: Hospira on 2025-02-07 and Hikma Portugal on 2023-04-21.

Our position: Corvale East is below target days on hand. Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside have sufficient supply to support transfers. An approved therapeutic interchange exists for Civica, Inc. product (NDC 72572016010) approved 2025-11-20.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 34 units from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 71 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Activate Civica, Inc. alternate manufacturer (NDC 72572016010) — approved by pharmacist.

Not recommended: Purchase from HF Acquisition Co LLC (DBA HealthFirst) or Henry Schein, Inc.; neither appears on FDA's shortage list and labels do not identify a known plant.
